title: Results delivery
description: Request body of POST {extranet}/monitoring/results. Raw check results, delivered on the cadence in fixtures/delivery-cadence.json. Idempotent on check_id. The hub replays these in checked_at order through its own state machine; the prober draws no conclusions about alerting.

dropped.description: Results lost to buffer overflow. The prober is never a history store; when a buffer fills, the oldest go and are reported here.

clamped.description: Monitors whose requested interval was raised to the tenant minimum, or to 60 minutes for a hibernating site. Reported so the hub can show the effective interval rather than the requested one.

usage.description: Month-to-date counters, so the hub holds a durable copy of what the prober did for this tenant.

location.description: A label the hub stores and displays. Nothing on the hub infers anything from it.

check_id.description: ULID, Crockford base32, uppercase. The hub's idempotency key; it returns the highest one it accepted so the prober can advance its cursor.

up.description: Whether the check passed. Replayed straight into the hub's recordUptimeResult().

served_from_cache.description: The response carried cf-cache-status: HIT or a non-zero Age, so it never reached the origin. A distinct condition from up or down: the hub should flag the misconfiguration rather than trust the result either way.
